flight-included.note: The headline case. Direct negation of the same fact.

booking-help-phrasing.note: Same meaning, different wording. A naive similarity check flags this.

beginners-welcome.note: Contradicts who the trip is for.

equipment-rental.note: Negation again, but phrased as absence rather than 'nicht'.

extra-detail-en.note: The English side adds information. Extra detail is not a contradiction.

deposit-refundable.note: Commercially important and easy to get wrong in translation.

weather-hedge.note: Hedged statement on both sides. Tempting to over-flag.

insurance-required.note: Requirement downgraded to a recommendation. Subtle but a real defect.

wifi-scope.note: Not a negation. The scope differs, which is harder to spot than a 'not'.

cancellation-window.note: Identical, including the number. Should be silent.

meals-half-board.note: Half board is more than breakfast. Needs domain reasoning, not word matching.

age-minimum-prose.note: Same rule, expressed with different emphasis. Numbers match so the rules layer stays quiet.
